recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
